content:
Here is the idiomatic `knr-ops` implementation for the new ACK-managed S3 logs bucket, IRSA, and Flux Kustomization.

### 📁 Directory Structure
```
knr-ops/
├── infra/
│   ├── s3/
│   │   ├── kustomization.yaml
│   │   ├── bucket.yaml
│   │   ├── versioning.yaml
│   │   ├── encryption.yaml
│   │   └── publicaccessblock.yaml
│   └── iam/
│       ├── kustomization.yaml
│       ├── role.yaml
│       ├── policy.yaml
│       ├── role-policy-attachment.yaml
│       ├── serviceaccount.yaml
│       └── secrets.yaml      # SOPS-encrypted sensitive IAM values
├── overlays/
│   ├── dev/kustomization.yaml
│   └── prod/kustomization.yaml
└── flux/
    └── kustomizations.yaml   # Updated with new Kustomization
```

---

### 📦 Base Resources

#### `infra/s3/kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - versioning.yaml
  - encryption.yaml
  - publicaccessblock.yaml
```

#### `infra/s3/bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    # Patched by overlays
    bucket: myapp-logs-PLACEHOLDER
```

#### `infra/s3/versioning.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: VersioningConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-versioning
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    versioning:
      - status: Enabled
```

#### `infra/s3/encryption.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: EncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-encryption
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    rule:
      - bucketKeyEnabled: true
        applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
```

#### `infra/s3/publicaccessblock.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: PublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-pab
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

---

### 🔐 Base IAM Resources

#### `infra/iam/kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - role.yaml
  - policy.yaml
  - role-policy-attachment.yaml
  - serviceaccount.yaml
  - secrets.yaml
```

#### `infra/iam/role.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/OIDC_ISSUER"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "OIDC_ISSUER:sub": "system:serviceaccount/NAMESPACE:myapp-logs-sa"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
```

#### `infra/iam/policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:ListBucket",
              "s3:DeleteObject"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-PLACEHOLDER",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-PLACEHOLDER/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
```

#### `infra/iam/role-policy-attachment.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-attachment
spec:
  forProvider:
    policyArnRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
    roleNameRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
```

#### `infra/iam/serviceaccount.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-sa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/myapp-logs-irsa
```
